name: Blueprint logic mod (UE4SS BPModLoader)
summary: A Blueprint mod made in the Unreal Editor and loaded by UE4SS from Content\Paks\LogicMods. For adding actors, widgets and game logic.
description: UE4SS's BPModLoaderMod spawns a Blueprint actor called ModActor from every pak in LogicMods. Blueprints cannot be written as text, so this project is the exact folder tree, the names that must match, a packing script that refuses a wrong layout, and step by step instructions for the editor side.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Without spaces this is the pak's name and the folder under Content\Mods. The two must be the same.

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The game's top folder (the one with the Engine folder in it). pack.bat installs the pak there. Leave empty to copy it by hand.

options.label: Game project folder
options.patternHelp: a folder name: letters, digits and _ only
options.help: The folder next to Engine in the game's install, the one with Content\Paks inside. Every path in the pak starts with it.

options.label: Pak format

choices.label: UE4, and UE5 games with only .pak files: one .pak
UE5 IoStore (the game has .utoc and .ucas files): .pak + .utoc + .ucas

options.help: Look in the game's Content\Paks folder. If it has .utoc files the game uses IoStore.

options.label: Engine version
options.help: The Unreal Engine version of the game. The editor you make the Blueprint in must be the same version.

next: Follow README.md, "Make the Blueprint": create Content\Mods\<mod>\ModActor in an Unreal Editor project of the game's engine version and cook it.
Copy the cooked ModActor files into the folder the README names.
Put UnrealPak.exe or repak.exe into the tools folder, then run pack.bat: it builds the pak and copies it to Content\Paks\LogicMods.
Start the game and look in UE4SS.log for the mod's name after "Loading mod".
